equivalence_note: Canada has no DTS with receipts/withdrawals, but the Receiver General publishes a DAILY closing cash balance at the BoC plus term deposits placed with banks (found in triangulation, verified 2026-09-08). Daily -dBalance is the analog of -dTGA; term deposits capture cash moved from the BoC to banks (reserve-adding without fiscal meaning). Issuance/redemption from auctions; net spending from monthly Fiscal Monitor (deferred).

rg_closing_balance.label: Receiver General closing cash balance at BoC

rg_term_deposits.label: RG term deposits at financial institutions
rg_term_deposits.equivalence_note: cash moved BoC→banks: adds reserves, not fiscal flow

government_deposits_banks.label: GoC deposits at chartered banks (monthly)

mmt_note.label: MMT note
mmt_note.text: Spending creates NFA; taxes destroy NFA; bond issuance drains reserves but does NOT change NFA (composition swap). Reserve impact and NFA creation are tracked as two separate lines (triangulation consensus).
